name: tests-75pct-google-workspace-mcp-bounded-google-api-e0fd
instr:
Add opt-in Google service reuse. Preserve existing behaviour.

ServiceCacheKey.create includes service, version, principal fingerprint, authentication mode, credential generation and effective scopes. Canonicalize scopes to a sorted duplicate-free tuple. Different components, delegated subjects, services or effective scope sets yield distinct identities; equivalent scope declarations share clients. Key representations redact raw principals.

GoogleServicePool returns separate leases over one client for concurrent equal-key acquisitions, shares builder failures and permits clean retries. Repeated acquisitions reuse retained clients. Disabled pools build fresh clients and start with disabled, zero aggregate state. Capacity pressure evicts the least-recently-released eligible entry while preserving active leases. invalidate(key) returns whether an entry existed, forces later rebuilding, preserves active callers and unrelated entries, and counts only affected entries. Credential-generation changes prevent old-client reuse.

ServiceLease.service() and context entry return the client. Context exit releases on success or exception; release is idempotent and updates active accounting. Released access raises ServiceLeaseReleased. A decorated RefreshError invalidates and releases the affected lease.

snapshot exposes only aggregate fields with accurate hits, misses, builds, evictions, invalidations, retained entries and active leases. Status observation does not build clients; CLI rend
